memories.content: ABC News/Washington Post is a major national polling organization. It regularly conducts and releases head-to-head surveys on presidential races. It has its own internal schedule and criteria for releasing polls.

The 2012 U.S. presidential election is between incumbent Barack Obama and challenger Mitt Romney. Major national polling organizations sometimes publicly release new head-to-head surveys. The first week of October 2012 runs from Monday October 1 to Sunday October 7, 2012.
